answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 9 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 620 identities costs 620 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the horizon here is verification, the lantern of cost is what stops the farm, and the ripple of the record keeps every claim checkable.
